motivation: R1 proved that exact seam alignment alone is insufficient. SWAP 4.3.1 defines the KSATEXM extension exactly linearly in relative saturation S, so R2 uses S itself as the wet-end table coordinate while retaining the already-qualified log-head coordinate on the dry side.

wet_region.physical_range: S from S(h=-1 cm) down to S_thr=S(h=-2 cm)
wet_region.coordinate_meaning: uniform relative saturation S, matching the exact variable of the linear KSATEXM conductivity extension
wet_region.head_reconstruction: qualified stable S-to-u mapping followed by h=-10^u, with exact endpoints h=-1 and h=-2

representation.exact_shared_seam: index 18 is exactly S_thr and h=-2 cm for both coordinate branches
representation.interpolation: bilinear in log mobility with float64 arithmetic in the local hybrid-axis cell

runtime_locator.dry_state: if S < S_thr: compute qualified u(S), then x=18+222*(u-log10(2))/(4-log10(2))
runtime_locator.domain: exact S domain corresponding to h=[-10000,-1] cm; no tolerance-based physical extension

characterization.probe_set: reuse frozen C2A development characterization probes; no holdout has been accessed
characterization.reason_for_18_wet_intervals: retain the same wet/dry interval budget and total N as R1; R2 changes only the wet coordinate variable, not density or memory

exit_rule.pass_all_six: freeze R2 and create a fresh 36-material KSATEXM holdout before any C2A catalog qualification claim
exit_rule.any_fail: reject R2 fail-closed. Only then investigate whether the wet region requires additional node density, a different stored quantity, or a separate analytic correction.

scope_guard: No h>-1 cm, no non-zero H_ENPR, no saturation switching, no heterogeneous profiles, no timestep qualification, no bottom boundary, no groundwater, no MultiSWAP production claim, no J1 response tangent and no FullRichards equivalence.
